verdict.rationale: Vast.ai ships an official CLI, a Python SDK and a REST API with an OpenAPI spec. Its docs say anything in the web console can be automated from the terminal, and they recommend scoped API keys specifically for CI/CD and automation. A runtime probe confirmed the CLI installs and runs headlessly, searching the live marketplace without interaction. Missing for 10: a documented CI pipeline integration example (e.g., a GitHub Actions workflow) and hands-on evidence of an authenticated end-to-end lifecycle run in CI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: For shared tooling, CI/CD, or automation, create a scoped key with only the permissions that workload needs.
Anything you can do in the web console, you can automate from your terminal.
The Vast.ai CLI gives you command-line access to the entire platform, authentication, GPU search, instance lifecycle, templates, volumes, serverless endpoints, and more.
the official Vast.ai CLI (pypi `vastai`) installed via uvx and ran keylessly — `vastai --help` prints the full command surface including search offers, create instance, and destroy instance.
